name: Notes App
note: A little native app. 'desktop' apps show running when a process named 'processName' (its .exe, without extension) is found.

name: Metrics Dashboard
note: A little web dashboard (Vite/React). 'web' apps show running when their port answers, and the browser opens when it goes live.

name: Habit Tracker
note: A small Python web app. Run a foreground command so its logs stream into the terminal; 'env' injects variables like PORT.

name: CLI Script
note: Runs a script and keeps an interactive shell open in 'cwd'. Use the unquoted '-NoExit -Command <tokens>' form; leave off '-Command ...' for a plain shell.

name: Docs Dashboard
note: A self-contained HTML dashboard. 'static' apps with only a 'url' just open it in the browser (no terminal).

name: Portable Dashboard
note: Portable-mode example: {MP_HOME} resolves to Moonpool's folder, so this entry travels with a zip/USB bundle. A ./-relative cwd works too. Tokens work in installed mode as well (there {MP_HOME} is the install dir).
